description:
The top plot illustrates the relationship between a variable $m$ and $n$. The x-axis represents $m$ on a linear scale, starting at 0 and extending rightward with an arrow, featuring a specific marked point $m_0$ and a dashed break ("......") indicating a skipped section of the axis. The y-axis represents $n$ on a linear scale, starting at 0 and extending upward with an arrow, with marked symbolic values at $w$, $c-a-s$, and $c-a$. The data is shown as a solid black line with no markers, forming a decreasing sawtooth pattern. The line begins at $y=0$ slightly to the right of the origin, rises linearly to a first peak at $y=c-a$, and drops vertically to a minimum at $y=w$. This pattern of linear growth followed by a vertical decline repeats, with subsequent peaks and minimums gradually decreasing in y-value across the x-axis. At the x-value $m_0$, the peak of the sawtooth aligns exactly with the y-value $c-a-s$, which is indicated by horizontal and vertical dashed guide lines.

The bottom plot illustrates the relationship between a variable $m$ and $Size_{run}^a$. The x-axis represents $m$ on a linear scale, starting at 0 and extending rightward with an arrow, featuring a marked point $m_0$ and a dashed break ("......") identical to the top plot. The y-axis represents $Size_{run}^a$ on a linear scale, starting at 0 and extending upward with an arrow, with marked symbolic values at $w+a+s$ and $c$. The data is displayed as a solid black line with no markers, forming a decreasing sawtooth pattern similar to the top plot. The line starts exactly at the origin (0,0), rises linearly to a first peak at $y=c$, and drops vertically to a minimum. The pattern repeats with both the peaks and the minimums gradually decreasing as $m$ increases. At the x-value $m_0$, the vertical drop of the sawtooth ends at a minimum that aligns exactly with the y-value $w+a+s$, which is indicated by horizontal and vertical dashed guide lines.
